question:
The following bar graph shows the sale of geometry boxes for 6 days in a stationary shop. What is the average sale per day?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71b40435307a3914aa9526a630449e2846587c3493d52210d20e3171a0f048f5.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The sale on Monday = 18

The sale on Tuesday = 15

The sale on Wednesday = 26

The sale on Thursday = 8

The sale on Friday = 16

The sale on Saturday = 13

**Formula used:**

Average={The sum of all the numbersover The number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the average sale id X

The sum of the sale for whole week = 18 + 15 + 26 + 8 + 16 + 13 = 96

The average = X ={96over6}=16

**∴ The required result will be 16.**
